args.description: List of command-line arguments for the executable

cpu_limit.description: CPU limit as a float or percentage (e.g., '0.5', '50%')

dependencies.description: List of service names this service depends on

environment.description: List of environment variables in 'KEY=VALUE' format

executable.description: Absolute path to the service executable

liveness_probe.description: Command to check if service is alive, e.g., '/usr/bin/81voltd health-check-alive'

log_directory.description: Directory where service logs are written

mounts.description: List of bind mounts, each with source, destination, and optional options (ro/rw,etc.)

port.description: Port number (int) or list of port numbers the service binds to

readiness_probe.description: Command to check if service is ready, e.g., '/usr/bin/81voltd health-check-ready'

restart_retries.description: Number of restart attempts before giving up (only used with 'on-failure' policy)

service_group.description: System group under which the service runs

service_user.description: System user under which the service runs

working_directory.description: Working directory for the service process
